a1-lesen-01-01: The text says *erst am Nachmittag*: the two work until 13 and come in the afternoon.
a1-lesen-01-02: *Am Abend koche ich für alle*: Sabine cooks for everyone in the evening.
a1-lesen-01-03: The meeting place is *vor der Schule*; from there they go to the zoo by bus.
a1-lesen-01-04: Entry is 6 Euro, *die Busfahrt ist frei*: 6 Euro in total.
a1-lesen-01-05: *Die Kinder brauchen Essen und Trinken*: the children bring their own food.
a1-lesen-01-06: A four-year-old child needs a *Kinderbett*; a *Doppelbett* is for two adults. The number 4 in the two ads tells you the age of the bed.
a1-lesen-01-07: Weekend = *Samstag und Sonntag*. The café is looking for staff only from Monday to Friday.
a1-lesen-01-08: For a repair you need a *Fahrradwerkstatt*. The other ad sells a bike; the word *kaputt* there is only about the light.
a1-lesen-01-09: For one week you rent a car: *Autovermietung*. The other ad is selling the car (*Verkaufe*).
a1-lesen-01-10: Someone who works during the day cannot go to the 9–13 course; the evening course *18.30–20 Uhr* fits.
a1-lesen-01-11: This pharmacy is closed, but the emergency pharmacy *Rosen-Apotheke, Uferweg 12* is open all night.
a1-lesen-01-12: Children under six can go in *nur zusammen mit einem Erwachsenen*; not alone.
a1-lesen-01-13: *Dieser Automat ist leider kaputt*: you cannot get money here; the nearest one is at the station.
a1-lesen-01-14: On Sunday there are rolls *ab 8 Uhr*; *halb neun* = 8.30, so there are fresh rolls at that time.
a1-lesen-01-15: Only this lift is broken; the one at platform 5 is working: *Aufzug an Gleis 5*.
a1-lesen-02-01: *Du musst mich nicht abholen*: Omar takes the tram, so Adam does not wait at the station.
a1-lesen-02-02: The match is on Saturday *um 15.30 Uhr*; that time is in the afternoon (*Nachmittag*).
a1-lesen-02-03: There is no water only from 8 to 12; *ab Mittag ist alles wieder normal*.
a1-lesen-02-04: *Sie müssen nicht zu Hause sein*: the workers are only working in the basement.
a1-lesen-02-05: The phone hours are *Montag bis Donnerstag*; not on Friday.
a1-lesen-02-06: Evening job: *ab 18 Uhr*. The other ad is for lunch, from 10 to 15.
a1-lesen-02-07: Little money: the second-hand machine for 90 Euro fits. A new one costs at least 399 Euro; only the delivery is *gratis*.
a1-lesen-02-08: A 30-year-old is an adult: *Kurs für Erwachsene*. The other course is for children aged 5–10.
a1-lesen-02-09: For three months: *vom 1.6. bis 31.8.* The other room asks for *mindestens ein Jahr*.
a1-lesen-02-10: On Saturday Dr. Vogel is closed (Monday–Friday). *Tierklinik am Zoo* is open at the weekend too.
a1-lesen-02-11: On Thursday there is a break between 12 and 15: at 14 the doctor’s practice is closed.
a1-lesen-02-12: *Telefonieren nur im Erdgeschoss*: phone calls are allowed on the ground floor, not anywhere else.
a1-lesen-02-13: The time is the same (14.20); only the platform changes: *Gleis 7*.
a1-lesen-02-14: For cash, go to *Kasse 1 und 2*; this checkout takes cards only.
a1-lesen-02-15: *Kommen Sie gern auf ein Glas vorbei*: Mei invites her neighbours too.
a1-lesen-03-01: *Um 10 Uhr muss ich zum Zahnarzt*: a dentist is a doctor too.
a1-lesen-03-02: It is the other way round: Lena will work for Nora on Friday, and Nora for Lena on Sunday.
a1-lesen-03-03: The exam starts at 9, and you are asked to come at 8.30: half an hour earlier.
a1-lesen-03-04: *Nicht in unserer Schule, sondern in der Volkshochschule*: the exam is in another building.
a1-lesen-03-05: The results come *mit der Post* two weeks later; you do not need to go to the school.
a1-lesen-03-06: The desk that is 1,10 m wide fits into a 1,20 m space; the 1,60 m one does not.
a1-lesen-03-07: *Sonntag Ruhetag* = closed on Sunday. Café Kanal serves breakfast at the weekend.
a1-lesen-03-08: To work every day, the job with 40 hours a week fits; the other job is only two weeks in August.
a1-lesen-03-09: You sell your car to the person who is looking for one: *Suche Kleinwagen*. The person in the other ad is selling a car too.
a1-lesen-03-10: *Nachhilfe für Schüler* = private lessons for pupils. In the other ad a student is looking for help herself.
a1-lesen-03-11: It is free only *jeden ersten Sonntag im Monat*: one Sunday a month.
a1-lesen-03-12: Only for supermarket customers and for two hours at most: *maximal 2 Stunden*.
a1-lesen-03-13: *Ab 1. Februar nur noch mit Termin*: it does not work without an appointment.
a1-lesen-03-14: It is not a must: you can also leave the key with a neighbour (*oder geben Sie den Schlüssel einem Nachbarn*).
a1-lesen-03-15: The shop closes on 31 March (*wir schließen*); in April it is no longer there.
a1-lesen-04-01: The food is ready, in the fridge: *du musst es nur warm machen* (he only has to heat it up).
a1-lesen-04-02: *Wir brauchen noch Brot, das kaufe ich*: Yasemin buys the bread.
a1-lesen-04-03: *Könnt ihr bitte einen Salat oder einen Kuchen mitbringen?*: the guests are asked to bring food.
a1-lesen-04-04: *Bei Regen feiern wir in der Wohnung*: if it rains, the party is in the flat.
a1-lesen-04-05: *Bitte schreibt uns bis Mittwoch: Wie viele Personen kommen?* So they want to know how many people are coming.
a1-lesen-04-06: *Gebraucht kaufen* = buying second-hand. The other page repairs phones; it does not sell them.
a1-lesen-04-07: *Hunde willkommen*: dogs are accepted. In the other hotel: *Haustiere leider nicht erlaubt*.
a1-lesen-04-08: A *Bürgeramt* is a public office (*Amt*): the opening hours are on the *Ämter* page.
a1-lesen-04-09: The page that sends flowers to a home: *Wir bringen Blumen*. The other one says *wir schicken nichts*: they do not deliver.
a1-lesen-04-10: A sports club for playing: *Neue Spieler willkommen*. On the other page you only watch the matches (*sehen*).
a1-lesen-04-11: *Bitte ohne Kinder kommen*: the parents should come without children.
a1-lesen-04-12: *Nur bar bezahlen* = cash only; cards are not accepted.
a1-lesen-04-13: On Saturday too, only until 20; 21 is too late.
a1-lesen-04-14: *Für Kinder bis 12 Jahre*: a nine-year-old child can play.
a1-lesen-04-15: The U2 does not run at the weekend; there is *Bus 140* instead.
a1-lesen-05-01: *Im Bad funktioniert sie noch*: the heating in the bathroom works.
a1-lesen-05-02: Nikos is off on Wednesday: *da geht es auch am Vormittag*; 10 is in the morning.
a1-lesen-05-03: *Der Trainer bleibt Tomasz Nowak*: the coach is the same; what changes is the day.
a1-lesen-05-04: *nicht mehr am Montag, sondern am Mittwoch*: the training is now on Wednesday.
a1-lesen-05-05: *Der Preis bleibt gleich*: the fee does not change.
a1-lesen-05-06: There is a garden and *Haustiere erlaubt*. The other flat has only a balcony, *keine Haustiere*.
a1-lesen-05-07: If you have no driving licence, you cannot drive the rental van; the moving company *mit Fahrer* fits.
a1-lesen-05-08: An instrument (*Klavier und Gitarre*) and *ab 6 Jahren*. The choir is for ages 16 and up, and there you sing.
a1-lesen-05-09: A tailor shortens trousers: *Wir machen Hosen und Jacken kürzer*. The shop only sells new trousers.
a1-lesen-05-10: You buy a present: *Buchhandlung* (bookshop). From the library you can only borrow books (*leihen*).
a1-lesen-05-11: *24 Stunden vorher* = one day before; the appointment must be cancelled by then.
a1-lesen-05-12: Last entry is *17 Uhr*; at 17.30 nobody is let in any more.
a1-lesen-05-13: The machine takes *keine Geldscheine*: you cannot buy a ticket with banknotes.
a1-lesen-05-14: On Sunday breakfast starts at 7.30; at 7 there is none yet.
a1-lesen-05-15: Today the restaurant is open *nur für die Hochzeitsgäste*; other guests can come tomorrow.
a1-lesen-06-01: *Zwei große Koffer*: that means a lot of luggage (*Gepäck*).
a1-lesen-06-02: *Bezahlen können Sie bar oder mit Karte*: paying by card is possible too.
a1-lesen-06-03: *In dieser Zeit hilft Ihnen Frau Dr. Seidel*: during the holiday another doctor helps.
a1-lesen-06-04: 15 August is the last day of the holiday; the practice opens *ab Montag, dem 18. August*.
a1-lesen-06-05: New hours: *jetzt auch am Mittwochnachmittag* — it is open on Wednesday afternoon too.
a1-lesen-06-06: The house on the North Sea is the one that is free in August. The other one is *schon voll* in July–August and free only from September.
a1-lesen-06-07: You have no car: at the bakery, *Auto von der Firma*. The pizza place is looking for a driver *mit eigenem Auto* (with their own car).
a1-lesen-06-08: You do not eat meat: the *vegetarisch* course fits. The barbecue course has only meat.
a1-lesen-06-09: A small fridge for a small kitchen: 85 cm high, 50 cm wide. The other one is 1,85 m.
a1-lesen-06-10: A place to sell at the flea market: *Plätze für Verkäufer*. The other ad buys things at your home; there is no market.
a1-lesen-06-11: *Am Freitag ist die Kita geschlossen*: the children cannot come that day.
a1-lesen-06-13: Visiting hours are 14–19; there are no visits in the morning.
a1-lesen-06-14: *Schon ab 6 Uhr*: that day the shop opens earlier, not later.
a1-lesen-06-15: Until 30 September the road is *für Autos geschlossen*; only pedestrians and bikes can get through.
a1-lesen-07-01: It has been raining for three days: *also war ich noch nicht schwimmen* (she has not been swimming at all yet).
a1-lesen-07-02: She comes back on Sunday and works on Monday: one day after her return.
a1-lesen-07-03: *Nicht am Montag, sondern am Mittwoch*: the meeting was moved to Wednesday.
a1-lesen-07-04: *Bitte schreibt eure Wünsche vorher auf*: they should be written down before the meeting.
a1-lesen-07-05: *Um 17 Uhr öffnen wir wie immer*: the restaurant opens on Wednesday too.
a1-lesen-07-06: The page that shows how to make a cake: *So machen Sie Kuchen und Brot*. On the café’s page you can only book a table.
a1-lesen-07-07: The price of a letter: *Preise für Briefe und Pakete in alle Länder*. The other page sells trips to Thailand.
a1-lesen-07-08: You are looking for a doctor today: addresses and consulting hours. The other page sends medicine in three days; there is no doctor.
a1-lesen-07-09: For tickets (*Karten*) there is *Ticket-Ecke*: it has sports tickets too. The other page has only results and news.
a1-lesen-07-10: You already have a profession and are looking for a job: *freie Stellen*. The other page offers three years of job training.
a1-lesen-07-11: The office sells from Monday to Thursday; not on Friday.
a1-lesen-07-12: On Saturday the bus only skips this stop; *nächste Haltestelle: Volkspark*.
a1-lesen-07-13: On Saturday *nur bis 12 Uhr*: closed in the afternoon.
a1-lesen-07-14: *Ich suche meine Katze*: their own cat is missing and they are looking for it; they do not want to buy a cat.
a1-lesen-07-15: Barbecuing is allowed *nur auf dem Grillplatz am See*: by the lake it is fine.
a1-lesen-08-01: She will stay in bed only until Wednesday; *am Donnerstag ist sie wieder da*.
a1-lesen-08-02: She is back at school on Thursday, so she is at school on Friday too; she wants to write the test.
a1-lesen-08-03: The box in front of the door is *Tag und Nacht offen*: you can leave the books there at night too.
a1-lesen-08-04: *Bitte bringen Sie die Bücher bis Samstag zurück*: Saturday at the latest, not Sunday.
a1-lesen-08-05: *können Sie die Zeit einmal online verlängern*: the time can be extended once.
a1-lesen-08-06: For guests: *Schlafsofa*; opened up, it becomes a 1,40 × 2,00 m bed. The leather sofa is for two people; it is not a bed.
a1-lesen-08-07: For today: *in 10 Minuten, ohne Termin*. The other studio gives appointments for two to three weeks later.
a1-lesen-08-08: Four years is within *von 3 bis 7 Jahren*. The *Babyschale* is only for up to 12 months.
a1-lesen-08-09: Summer holidays = *Juli und August*. The supermarket is looking for staff from October.
a1-lesen-08-10: At 23 at night only the locksmith who works *Tag und Nacht* comes. The other shop closes at 18 and only copies keys.
a1-lesen-08-11: *25 Minuten Verspätung*: today the train leaves later, at 10.40.
a1-lesen-08-12: Only the machine is broken; there is coffee *in der Cafeteria im 1. Stock*.
a1-lesen-08-13: There are no tickets left for this evening, but *für morgen haben wir noch Plätze*.
a1-lesen-08-14: On Monday evening there are lessons; the registration office is open only on Tuesday and Thursday, 10–17.
a1-lesen-08-15: From May it is on Wednesday and Saturday: two days a week.
a1-lesen-09-01: The guided tour starts at 10 and ends at 12: two hours.
a1-lesen-09-02: It is free only for course participants; *alle anderen Besucher bezahlen 8 Euro*.
a1-lesen-09-03: *Ich habe Ihr Paket genommen*: the parcel is at the neighbour’s, not at the post office.
a1-lesen-09-04: *Ab 18 Uhr*: before that the neighbour is at sport; at 17 she is not at home.
a1-lesen-09-05: *Morgen bin ich den ganzen Tag im Büro*: tomorrow she is at work all day.
a1-lesen-09-06: You do not smoke: the *Nichtraucher* flat fits. In the other flat everyone smokes.
a1-lesen-09-07: Only at the weekend: *am Samstag und Sonntag*. At the other school the lessons are on weekday evenings.
a1-lesen-09-08: For 40 people: *Raum für Feste bis 60 Personen*. The bistro has only eight tables.
a1-lesen-09-09: The size matters: *Größe 128*. The other jacket is size 152, too big.
a1-lesen-09-10: The place that is open after 20: *Tag und Nacht geöffnet*. The other gym closes at 20.
a1-lesen-09-11: Lunch is until 14; at 14.30 there is none left.
a1-lesen-09-12: *Straßenschuhe bleiben draußen*: you can go into the hall only in sports shoes.
a1-lesen-09-13: *immer 35 Euro – am Tag und in der Nacht*: the same price at night too.
a1-lesen-09-14: You can come without an appointment too, but you wait longer (*länger warten*).
a1-lesen-09-15: On Thursday it is *länger geöffnet: bis 19 Uhr*.
a1-lesen-10-01: The first meeting is *am Dienstag, dem 9. Februar*; the internship itself starts in March.
a1-lesen-10-02: *Am Freitag haben Sie frei für Ihren Deutschkurs*: she does not work on Friday.
a1-lesen-10-03: *Bitte stellen Sie Ihre Räder ab sofort in den Fahrradkeller*: from now on the bikes go in the cellar.
a1-lesen-10-04: *Kinderwagen dürfen im Erdgeschoss bleiben*: prams can stay on the ground floor.
a1-lesen-10-05: This week it is the Nowak family; the Kamau family’s turn is *nächste Woche*.
a1-lesen-10-06: *Alles kostenlos* = everything is free, and it is online. The language school costs 240 Euro a month and is in a classroom.
a1-lesen-10-07: The page that finds a doctor by language: *nach Ort, Fach und Sprache*. The other one is an Arabic course.
a1-lesen-10-08: Giving things away (*verschenken*): *Geben und nehmen … alles gratis*. The other page sells new furniture.
a1-lesen-10-09: In the rain the museum works, and it is open on Sunday too. The playground is open *nur bei gutem Wetter*.
a1-lesen-10-10: *Führerschein aus dem Ausland* = a driving licence from abroad: the information you need is here. The other page buys and sells cars.
a1-lesen-10-11: *Anmeldung ab sofort*: registration for the April course is already open.
a1-lesen-10-12: *Wir suchen Verkäufer/innen und Fahrer/innen*: the supermarket is looking for staff.
a1-lesen-10-13: Guests who come late call ahead and the key is left in the box: you can get into your room after 22 too.
a1-lesen-10-14: *Wir rufen Sie mit Ihrer Nummer*: they call your number, not your name.
a1-lesen-10-15: Guests can play too: *Platz 4 können Gäste mieten*.
a1-hoeren-01-01: The rolls are gone (*die Brötchen sind schon weg*) and she doesn’t like cake much: *Dann nehme ich ein Brot*.
a1-hoeren-01-02: The normal price is 60 euros; today it is *15 Euro billiger*: 60 − 15 = 45 euros.
a1-hoeren-01-03: The film at 20 is full and 18.30 is too early for him; he takes the tickets *für halb neun*: 20.30.
a1-hoeren-01-04: This time they are not going to Krakau: *Wir bleiben in Hamburg, zu Hause*. Aisha is the one going to Berlin.
a1-hoeren-01-05: He needs no tablets and doesn’t have to stay in bed; the important thing is: *trinken Sie viel Tee und Wasser*.
a1-hoeren-01-06: The name is spelled out: *L – I – N – D – N – E – R*. The fourth letter is D (not T), and there is no E after the D.
a1-hoeren-01-07: The time changes, not the platform: the train has *20 Minuten Verspätung* and still leaves from *Gleis 4*.
a1-hoeren-01-08: The store closes in ten minutes: *Bitte gehen Sie jetzt zur Kasse* — so people should pay now.
a1-hoeren-01-09: The car cannot stay in front of the entrance; *Der Parkplatz ist hinter dem Haus*: he should park there.
a1-hoeren-01-10: *Bitte kommen Sie sofort* and the plane waits only five minutes: she has no time.
a1-hoeren-01-11: On Wednesday and Friday it is *nur am Vormittag, von 8 bis 12 Uhr*; the days open until 18 are Monday, Tuesday and Thursday.
a1-hoeren-01-12: The drinks are ready and Jonas is making the salad; what Mei is asked for: *Kannst du einen Kuchen backen?*
a1-hoeren-01-13: They meet *vor dem Kino*; not the park this time (*Nicht im Volkspark*), and the kiosk is only where Omar is now.
a1-hoeren-01-14: He can’t come on Tuesday and the office is closed on Wednesday; the technician comes *am Donnerstag*.
a1-hoeren-01-15: *Der Kurs kostet 120 Euro*; 18 euros is the extra price for the book.
a1-hoeren-02-01: He doesn’t want coffee and there is no orange juice left; in the end he says *Dann nehme ich einen Tee*.
a1-hoeren-02-02: Number 14 goes to the station; for the zoo it is *die 44* (vierundvierzig). 14 and 44 sound alike.
a1-hoeren-02-03: Monday is full and Friday at 8 in the morning is too early for her: *Ich nehme den Mittwoch*.
a1-hoeren-02-04: The fourth floor is his old flat; *Meine neue Wohnung ist im zweiten Stock*. On the ground floor there is a bakery.
a1-hoeren-02-05: Two kilos cost 5 euros, but he takes only one kilo: *2 Euro 99*.
a1-hoeren-02-06: The name is spelled out: *W – A – G – N – E – R*. The first letter is W (not V), the second is A (not E).
a1-hoeren-02-07: Today the underground goes *nur bis Marktstraße*; from there bus 140 takes you to the zoo.
a1-hoeren-02-08: Tomorrow is a public holiday: *bleibt unser Markt geschlossen* — the supermarket is closed.
a1-hoeren-02-09: The meeting point is *nicht an der Kasse, sondern im ersten Stock vor dem Café*.
a1-hoeren-02-10: It rains in the morning, but *am Nachmittag scheint die Sonne*: the weather is nice in the afternoon.
a1-hoeren-02-11: The Tuesday appointment is cancelled; Thursday at 9 is full, the free time is *um 14 Uhr*.
a1-hoeren-02-12: He is waiting at the stop: *Der Bus … hat zwanzig Minuten Verspätung*.
a1-hoeren-02-13: The bread is already bought and there are eggs; what is missing is milk: *wir haben keine Milch mehr*.
a1-hoeren-02-14: The address is *Gartenstraße 15* (fünfzehn); at number 50 (fünfzig) there is the office.
a1-hoeren-02-15: It is not ready this evening and they are closed on Saturday: *Sie können es morgen früh ab 8 Uhr abholen*.
a1-hoeren-03-01: The advert says four, but that is a mistake: *Es sind drei* — three rooms.
a1-hoeren-03-02: Agata is the one learning Turkish; Tomasz says *Ich lerne Spanisch*. He already knows English.
a1-hoeren-03-03: The car is broken and it is too far by bike: *Ich nehme jetzt die Straßenbahn*.
a1-hoeren-03-04: May only sounds like her name; *Ich habe im Juli Geburtstag*. Her brother is the one born in June.
a1-hoeren-03-05: The post office in Marktstraße has closed; *Jetzt ist die Post im Bahnhof*. Bahnhofstraße is only the way there.
a1-hoeren-03-06: The name is spelled out: *F – R – A – N – K*. The last letter is K; no E comes after it.
a1-hoeren-03-07: The parents of class 3b go *nicht in Raum 104, sondern in die Bibliothek im Erdgeschoss*.
a1-hoeren-03-08: *Rauchen ist auf dem ganzen Schiff verboten*: smoking is not allowed on the ship.
a1-hoeren-03-09: The match starts *nicht um 15 Uhr 30, sondern erst um 16 Uhr*: half an hour later.
a1-hoeren-03-10: The luggage comes *nicht an Band 3, sondern an Band 5*.
a1-hoeren-03-11: The children’s film is *um 15 Uhr*; at 17.30 and 20 there is a comedy, and 14 is when the ticket office opens.
a1-hoeren-03-12: The book waits *bis Samstag*; on Monday it goes to someone else. Friday is only today’s day.
a1-hoeren-03-13: Four adults and two children: *also sechs Personen*.
a1-hoeren-03-14: The flight is *am dreizehnten August* (the 13th); *am dritten August* (the 3rd) was full.
a1-hoeren-03-15: The Tuesday appointment is cancelled; for a new time, *Bitte rufen Sie uns an* — she should call back.
a1-hoeren-04-01: He wants ten, but the packs have 6 or 12; six is too few for him: *die Packung mit zwölf*.
a1-hoeren-04-02: Normally 16.15, but today it is late: *Er kommt erst um 16 Uhr 50*.
a1-hoeren-04-03: He already has a ball and a bike is too expensive; Rami’s idea: *Kauf ihm doch ein Buch*.
a1-hoeren-04-04: She doesn’t like red any more and blue was too expensive: *Jetzt habe ich ein graues Sofa*.
a1-hoeren-04-05: Straight on to the traffic lights, and at the lights *nicht links …, sondern rechts*: to the right.
a1-hoeren-04-06: The name is spelled out: *B – Ö – T – T – C – H – E – R*. The second letter is Ö (not O), and T is said twice.
a1-hoeren-04-07: *Kinder essen heute kostenlos*: the meal is free for children; 5,90 euros is the price for adults.
a1-hoeren-04-08: Today the swimming pool closes *schon um 18 Uhr*: everyone has to leave earlier than usual.
a1-hoeren-04-09: Today the train leaves *nicht von Gleis 7, sondern von Gleis 9*.
a1-hoeren-04-10: The course is not cancelled; it only starts later: *erst um 10 Uhr*.
a1-hoeren-04-11: The course starts *nicht am Montag, sondern erst am Samstag*; on Wednesday there is a parents’ evening.
a1-hoeren-04-12: *Uferweg 17 – eins, sieben*; 70 (siebzig) is the house opposite. 17 and 70 sound alike.
a1-hoeren-04-13: On Friday it is 59 euros; *Am Samstag … nur 39 Euro*.
a1-hoeren-04-14: The entrance is very crowded and there is no need to go to the ticket desk: *Ich sitze im Café im ersten Stock*.
a1-hoeren-04-15: He has his phone and his key; what he is looking for is his glasses: *Liegt meine Brille … noch auf deinem Schreibtisch?*
a1-hoeren-05-01: The meal costs *13 Euro 50*; 20 euros is the money she gives, and 6,50 euros is the change.
a1-hoeren-05-02: There is no table at 19 and 18 is too early for him: *Dann um 20 Uhr, bitte*.
a1-hoeren-05-03: The mother works until six and the grandmother is in Krakau; the father says *dann hole ich sie ab*.
a1-hoeren-05-04: What he asks for is *Mehl* (flour); the sugar is only the shelf next to it, and he doesn’t need salt.
a1-hoeren-05-05: The room is *130 – eins, drei, null*; 113 is what Omar heard wrongly.
a1-hoeren-05-06: The name is spelled out: *J – Ä – G – E – R*. The second letter is Ä: it is said “A-Umlaut” (not A or E).
a1-hoeren-05-07: Today the train runs *ohne Restaurant*: food has to be bought at the station.
a1-hoeren-05-08: *Machen Sie Ihre Handys aus*: phones must be switched off.
a1-hoeren-05-09: The flight leaves with *eine Stunde Verspätung*: it is not on time.
a1-hoeren-05-10: *Wir öffnen eine neue Kasse*: checkout 3 is opening now.
a1-hoeren-05-11: The medicine did not arrive today; *Sie können es morgen ab 8 Uhr abholen*.
a1-hoeren-05-12: Not the restaurant, and her flat is small: *also feiern wir im Volkspark, am See*.
a1-hoeren-05-13: There is no sport tomorrow, the class goes to the library: she needs *ihren Bibliotheksausweis*, not trainers.
a1-hoeren-05-14: The room is 75 euros, *mit Frühstück 85 Euro*.
a1-hoeren-05-15: There is no course on Tuesday and Wednesday is not possible either: *Wir kochen am Donnerstag um 18 Uhr*.
a1-hoeren-06-01: By day it is 12 euros, but *in der Nacht kostet es 22*: the man pays 22 euros.
a1-hoeren-06-02: With the television and the temperature it is *alles in Ordnung*; the problem is: *im Bad ist kein Handtuch*.
a1-hoeren-06-03: Three brothers and two sisters: five in total (*Fünf Geschwister!*).
a1-hoeren-06-04: Normally 9, but today *erst um halb zehn*: 9.30.
a1-hoeren-06-05: The perfume is too expensive and his wife doesn’t eat chocolate: *Dann kaufe ich Blumen*.
a1-hoeren-06-06: The name is spelled out: *H – A – R – T – M – A – N – N*. The fourth letter is T (not D), and there are two N at the end.
a1-hoeren-06-07: Because of the delay, coffee and tea are *zum halben Preis*: half price.
a1-hoeren-06-08: Today it is open *nur bis 14 Uhr*; until 20 is tomorrow.
a1-hoeren-06-09: *Für Kinder gibt es im Park Spiele und ein Puppentheater*; in front of the town hall there is music.
a1-hoeren-06-10: The information desk is closed, but you can still borrow books *an den Automaten im Erdgeschoss*.
a1-hoeren-06-11: There is a party on Friday: it closes *schon um 14 Uhr, nicht um 16 Uhr*.
a1-hoeren-06-12: *Ich möchte wandern gehen*; it is too cold for swimming, and tennis is no good either.
a1-hoeren-06-13: The number is said digit by digit: *vier, fünf, sechs, sieben, zwei, null* = 45 67 20.
a1-hoeren-06-14: *Ich bin mit Sami noch beim Arzt*; he wants Hanan to go to the supermarket.
a1-hoeren-06-15: The course is *35 Euro im Monat*; 25 euros is only for students.
a1-hoeren-07-01: Not every day: *Nur zweimal pro Woche*. What happens once a month is the match: *einmal im Monat*.
a1-hoeren-07-02: *Ich bin Mechatroniker*; Aisha is the taxi driver, and cooking is only his hobby.
a1-hoeren-07-03: No rain and no sun either; it is cold: *ich nehme meine Jacke*.
a1-hoeren-07-04: Omar can’t come and Aisha is working; the guests are Nikos, Sabine, Jonas and Mei: *das sind vier*.
a1-hoeren-07-05: In Germany it is *erst zwei* years; three years is the total time she has been learning German.
a1-hoeren-07-06: The name is spelled out: *Z – E – L – L – E – R*. The first letter is Z (not S), and L is said twice.
a1-hoeren-07-07: *Lassen Sie Ihr Gepäck nicht allein*: you have to stay with your luggage.
a1-hoeren-07-08: The escalator is broken, but there are two ways: *den Aufzug oder die Treppe*.
a1-hoeren-07-09: *Steigen bitte hier um*: passengers for Bonn get off in Köln and change to the train on platform 6.
a1-hoeren-07-10: A thunderstorm is coming: *Bitte gehen Sie sofort aus dem Wasser*.
a1-hoeren-07-11: The first driving lesson is *am Dienstag um 16 Uhr*; Monday at 18 is the theory class.
a1-hoeren-07-12: *Bring bitte die Fotos … mit*; her mother is baking the cake herself and already has a book.
a1-hoeren-07-13: The morning is not possible; the van comes *zwischen 14 und 17 Uhr*: in the afternoon.
a1-hoeren-07-14: Tomorrow he is not coming to the workshop here: *Wir brauchen Sie im Autohaus am Hafen*.
a1-hoeren-07-15: She leaves work at 18 and the film is at 19; they meet *um halb sieben*: 18.30.
a1-hoeren-08-01: On Saturday *eine Stunde später, um 7*; 6 is on weekdays, 8 is on Sunday.
a1-hoeren-08-02: Living alone is expensive: *Ich wohne mit einer Freundin zusammen*. Her brother is in Bangkok.
a1-hoeren-08-03: 22 square metres is the kitchen; the room is *12 Quadratmeter* (zwölf).
a1-hoeren-08-04: No headache this time: *heute ist es der Rücken* — his back hurts.
a1-hoeren-08-05: The swimming pool is closed on Mondays and the playground is for tomorrow: *Wir gehen in den Zoo*.
a1-hoeren-08-06: The name is spelled out: *V – O – G – T*. The first letter is V (not F); there is no I after the O.
a1-hoeren-08-07: The train *fällt heute leider aus*: it is not running today; people go to Potsdam by suburban train (S-Bahn).
a1-hoeren-08-08: Visitors only watch (*ihr könnt zusehen*); they do not feed the elephants.
a1-hoeren-08-09: The weather in Istanbul is *sonnig, 28 Grad*: sunny, no rain.
a1-hoeren-08-10: The children’s department is *nicht mehr im ersten Stock, sondern im dritten*; the first floor now has sports goods.
a1-hoeren-08-11: Work normally starts at 8, but on the first day: *Kommen Sie bitte um 7 Uhr*.
a1-hoeren-08-12: The sports hall is closed; training is *auf dem Sportplatz hinter der Schule, nicht im Park*.
a1-hoeren-08-13: The new screen, that is the repair, costs *60 Euro*; 100 euros is how much more a new phone costs.
a1-hoeren-08-14: The shelves are very heavy: *Kannst du mir helfen?* — he is asking for help.
a1-hoeren-08-15: No passport is needed and the tenancy agreement can be sent later; what he should bring: *ein neues Foto*.
a1-hoeren-09-01: The child is five: *Kinder unter sechs Jahren bezahlen bei uns nichts*. 6 euros is the adult ticket.
a1-hoeren-09-02: On weekdays it is 22.15; today is Saturday: *da fährt der letzte erst um 23 Uhr 15*.
a1-hoeren-09-03: Not books this time: *diesmal sind es Schuhe*. The dress comes next week.
a1-hoeren-09-04: She stays in Hamburg *nur zwei Wochen*; one week is the trip to London afterwards.
a1-hoeren-09-05: At three she has *einen Termin beim Friseur*; she studies German in the evening, and Can is cooking.
a1-hoeren-09-06: The name is spelled out: *B – A – C – H – M – A – N – N*. The first letter is B (not P), and there are two N at the end.
a1-hoeren-09-07: The machine is broken: *Bitte geben Sie Ihre Flaschen an der Information ab*.
a1-hoeren-09-08: The train leaves *in zwei Minuten*: that means very soon (*gleich*).
a1-hoeren-09-09: It is very hot: lessons end *schon um 12 Uhr*, so the pupils leave early.
a1-hoeren-09-10: The cocoa is *kostenlos* for the children: free.
a1-hoeren-09-11: *Heute … bis 16 Uhr*; it is tomorrow that it is open until 18.
a1-hoeren-09-12: She has her course on Friday and Can works on Saturday; the invitation is *am Sonntag … um 13 Uhr*.
a1-hoeren-09-13: She has enough boxes and Jonas is bringing the van; what is missing: *hast du vielleicht Werkzeug?* (tools).
a1-hoeren-09-14: There is no appointment today and next week it is closed: *Kommen Sie bitte morgen um 8 Uhr 30*.
a1-hoeren-09-15: The test is moved to next week; *Morgen sehen wir zusammen einen Film*. The lesson starts at 9 as usual.
a1-hoeren-10-01: 350 euros is without electricity and heating; *Mit allem sind es 380 Euro*.
a1-hoeren-10-02: On Tuesday there is the school festival; *Der Elternabend ist am Donnerstag*.
a1-hoeren-10-03: It is the tyres that are three years old; *Das Auto ist acht Jahre alt*.
a1-hoeren-10-04: No night shift: *Diese Woche arbeite ich von 6 bis 14 Uhr*; her afternoon is free.
a1-hoeren-10-05: Nikos is bringing the drinks and the music is ready; Tomasz brings *sechs Stühle*.
a1-hoeren-10-06: The name is spelled out: *K – A – Y – A*. The first letter is K (not G), the third is Y (“Ypsilon”; not J).
a1-hoeren-10-07: The discount is *nur heute*: only today, not the whole week.
a1-hoeren-10-08: There is no carriage 7; in carriage 9 *sind Plätze für Sie frei*.
a1-hoeren-10-09: Herr Khalil is called to room 2; Frau Krüger has to go *zur Anmeldung*.
a1-hoeren-10-10: *Getränke dürfen Sie leider nicht mit in den Saal nehmen*: you cannot go into the hall with a drink.
a1-hoeren-10-11: He needs no present and there is food too; what is asked for: *geben Sie ihm Sportsachen mit*.
a1-hoeren-10-12: The lake is cancelled because of the rain: *Wir gehen zusammen ins Kino am Kanal*.
a1-hoeren-10-13: Not until 20 as usual: *sondern bis 23 Uhr*.
a1-hoeren-10-14: The ticket says 2, but today the train leaves *von Gleis 12* (zwölf); 20 is the arrival time.
a1-hoeren-10-15: The new glasses are ready; *Bitte bringen Sie die alte Brille mit*.
